scores.summary: [HEARTBEAT_LOST] Robot R-07 is offline with no heartbeat, indicating potential hardware failure. Job J-0008 reassignment to R-08 failed due to R-08 being busy. Escalated incident for maintenance inspection to verify hardware status and resolve the offline state.

[HEARTBEAT_LOST] Job J-0006 was reassigned to robot R-11 due to R-10's offline status. Incident escalated for maintenance to investigate potential hardware fault. No immediate high-risk actions required.
[HEARTBEAT_LOST] Robot R-09 is offline with HEARTBEAT_LOST. Job J-0013 has been reassigned to R-15. Escalated to maintenance for further inspection of R-09.

[JOB_TIMEOUT] Job J-0009 timed out on robot R-06 (battery 73%, status WORKING). No available robots to reassign after attempting to transfer to R-07 (busy). Marking incident resolved; monitor for recurring timeouts.
[JOB_TIMEOUT] Job J-0011 timed out on robot R-02, but battery (74%) and movement data show no faults. Reassigned to robot R-07. No escalation needed.

[JOB_TIMEOUT] Robot R-13's job J-0010 timed out, but the robot is still working with 91% battery and no faults. Reassigning the job to another robot to recover progress. No escalation needed as no hardware issues detected.
[LOW_BATTERY] Robot R-09 (11% battery) was sent to charging while working. Job J-0001 reassigned automatically. No escalation needed as low battery is resolved by charging.

[LOW_BATTERY] Robot R-01 (11% battery) was sent to charging while reassigning job J-0012 to available robot R-15. Battery level is critically low while working, requiring immediate charging to prevent downtime.
[LOW_BATTERY] Robot R-12 (10% battery) is being sent to charge. Its job J-0011 will return to the queue. No escalation needed as this is a low-risk battery depletion event.

[SENSOR_FAULT] SENSOR_FAULT detected on robot R-11 (fault code: SENSOR_FAULT). Robot is marked FAULTED and proposed for setOutOfService. Escalated to maintenance for inspection. Incident resolved with status ACKED. No further action required.
[SENSOR_FAULT] Robot R-12 with SENSOR_FAULT is out of service and requires maintenance. Incident acknowledged and escalated to maintenance team.
[SENSOR_FAULT] Robot R-02 has a SENSOR_FAULT code and is FAULTED. Propose taking it out of service and escalate to maintenance for sensor repair.
[STUCK] Robot R-09 is stuck near AISLE_2 (zone not blocked). Proposing resetRobot to resolve potential temporary motor issues.

[STUCK] Robot R-02 is stuck (stuckTicks=8) with no blocked zone nearby. A resetRobot proposal (P-0001) has been sent to an operator for approval and has not yet executed. No immediate action required.

[STUCK] Robot R-03 is stuck in AISLE_2 (non-blocked zone) with no fault code detected. Proposed resetRobot to clear potential software jam. No escalation needed as the issue may resolve with a restart.
[NONE] The incident is already resolved. Robot R-09 is operational with sufficient battery and no faults detected. No further action required.

[SENSOR_FAULT] Robot R-06 is marked OUT_OF_SERVICE due to SENSOR_FAULT (fault code). Maintenance is required as this issue cannot be resolved through software reset. The robot's job J-0002 has been returned to the queue. | [LOW_BATTERY] Robot R-13 (11% battery) was sent to charge while working on job J-0006. The reassignment attempt failed because R-08 was busy, but the job will be available for reassignment once R-13 returns from charging. No escalation needed for this low-battery event.

[ZONE_BLOCKED] AISLE_2 is blocked, causing robots R-03, R-06, and R-07 to be stuck. Proposed rerouteAround(AISLE_2) is pending operator approval. Escalate to clear the blocked zone and restore traffic flow.
[ZONE_BLOCKED] AISLE_3 is blocked, causing robots R-11, R-12, R-13, and R-02 to get stuck. Proposed rerouteAround(AISLE_3) to bypass the blocked zone. Escalate to clear the obstruction.

[ZONE_BLOCKED] Multiple robots (R-01, R-10, R-12, R-15, R-16, R-07) are stuck near the blocked AISLE_2 zone. Proposed rerouteAround(AISLE_2) to avoid the blockage. Escalate to clear the blocked zone as it affects multiple robots.
